description: BeWaPP - poubelles, cendriers et équipements de propreté publique is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by BeWaPP. Service reprenant les poubelles, les cendriers et les autres infrastructures de la propreté publique The 3 datasets in this record: Cendrier; Infrastructure; Poubelle. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal lists 3 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are PRO-preté, Public, Propreté publique, Poubelles, Cendriers, Infrastructures. The portal shows 390 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
